Nearest Kickoff

Terms of use

Last updated 23 November 2026

What this site is

Nearest Kickoff shows upcoming football fixtures on a map so you can see what is being played near where you are. It is free to use, run by Carlos M, and that is the whole of it.

Fixtures change, and we will sometimes be wrong

Kick-off times move for television, matches are postponed for weather and cup replays, and some leagues publish only a date range until a broadcaster picks the slot. We rebuild from the published calendars regularly and we show a match's kick-off time only when the source gives one, but a fixture here is not a guarantee that the match is on.

Check with the club before you travel or book anything. That goes double for a match shown without a kick-off time, or one shown with a date range rather than a day. We cannot be responsible for a wasted journey, a non-refundable booking, or a missed match.

Where the pin is

A solid pin is the stadium itself. A hollow pin is the centre of the town, and means we could not confirm the ground — it is roughly right, not precisely right, which is why it offers a map search instead of driving directions. Credits explains how venues are sourced and checked.

We do not sell tickets

No ticket is sold on this site and no booking is taken here. Where a link goes to a club's own ticket office or to a ticket seller, that sale is between you and them, on their terms, and any question about price, delivery, refunds or entry is theirs to answer. See the affiliate disclosure for whether we are paid for such a link.

Not affiliated with anyone

Nearest Kickoff is independent. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, licensed by or connected to any club, league, federation, broadcaster or ticket seller. Club and competition names appear only to identify the fixtures they describe.

Using the site

Use it as much as you like, personally or at work. Please do not scrape it in a way that degrades it for other people, present the data as your own, or use it to break the law. The underlying fixture, venue and map data comes from the open sources listed in Credits, under the licences named there — if you want the data, take it from those sources rather than from us, and honour their terms.

Liability

The site is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for loss arising from use of the site or reliance on anything shown on it. Nothing here limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited, and nothing here affects your statutory rights as a consumer.

Changes, and getting in touch

These terms may change; the date at the top moves when they do. These terms are governed by the law of the United States. Questions, corrections and complaints: contact@nearestkickoff.com.
